items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: all the Chuck Barris things, “The Gong Show,” “The $1.98 Beauty Show”

ctx.x: T.V. and film and commercials, and just anything.

Yeah. Records. But a lot of them, my niche, they kind of put you where they want you, and my niche was live television. And so I did all the, well I did part of “The Joey Bishop Show,” “The Della Reese Show,” “The Tony Orlando and Dawn Show,” all the Chuck Barris things, “The Gong Show,” “The $1.98 Beauty Show” “Dinah Shore,” I can’t even think of all of them. But people used to put down live television because sometimes the music was so bad — well no not the music bad, but you just sat around all day long. Like…

And I walked in there and they wanted him to stay to do this one take and he did, and thank God he did it because there was nobody, I mean it was just him all by himself and he started on a high F on soprano, triple piano, just bing. And I realized then, I don’t want to do this. I really don’t have the time to keep that up on those horns to make it my life’s work to do it. And I feel that way today too, I don’t want to do that kind of work. You know you die.
